overview: The paper proposes REASONINGBANK, a memory framework that distills reasoning strategies from agent successes and failures, and MATTS, a memory-aware test-time scaling method, to enable LLM agents to self-evolve and improve effectiveness and efficiency in web browsing and software engineering tasks.

modules.name: Memory Schema & Storage Engine
modules.description: Defines the structured schema for memory items (Title, Description, Content) and manages the persistence of the memory bank in JSON format, handling CRUD operations for the experience repository.

modules.name: Memory Retrieval Engine
modules.description: Computes embeddings for incoming task queries using an embedding model and performs similarity search against the stored memory pool to retrieve the top-k relevant memory items.

modules.name: Memory Extraction Pipeline
modules.description: Processes completed agent trajectories using specialized LLM prompts to distill high-level, transferable reasoning patterns from successful trajectories and reflective lessons from failed trajectories into structured memory items.

modules.name: Memory Consolidation Manager
modules.description: Integrates newly extracted memory items into the existing ReasoningBank using a simple addition strategy, updating the memory repository and pre-computing embeddings for future retrieval.

modules.name: Agent Environment Interface
modules.description: Wraps the interactive environments (BrowserGym for web tasks and Bash-only shell for SWE tasks), handling action execution, state transitions, and extraction of observations like accessibility trees or code snippets.

modules.name: ReAct Agent Controller
modules.description: Implements the core agent loop following the ReAct paradigm, integrating retrieved memory items into the system prompt, managing the thought-action-observation cycle, and enforcing step limits.

modules.name: LLM-as-a-Judge Evaluator
modules.description: Provides proxy correctness signals for agent trajectories by prompting an LLM to classify the outcome of a trajectory as success or failure based on the user intent, trajectory history, and final state.

modules.name: MATTS Parallel Scaling Controller
modules.description: Orchestrates parallel test-time scaling by generating multiple independent trajectories for the same query, enabling diverse exploration guided by current memory.

modules.name: MATTS Sequential Scaling Controller
modules.description: Implements sequential test-time scaling by iteratively refining a single trajectory through self-refinement loops, capturing intermediate reasoning signals and corrections.

modules.name: Self-Contrast & Self-Refine Extractors
modules.description: Specialized memory extraction modules for MATTS; the self-contrast extractor compares multiple parallel trajectories to identify consistent patterns and filter spurious solutions, while the self-refine extractor captures insights from intermediate refinement steps.

modules.name: Best-of-N Selection Module
modules.description: Evaluates multiple candidate trajectories generated during parallel scaling using an LLM-based ranking prompt to select the single best trajectory as the final output based on progress, efficiency, and loop detection.

modules.name: WebArena Benchmark Runner
modules.description: Manages the evaluation pipeline for web browsing tasks on the WebArena benchmark, handling task streaming, agent invocation, and environment reset across multiple domains (Shopping, Admin, Gitlab, Reddit, Multi).

modules.name: Mind2Web Benchmark Runner
modules.description: Configures and executes the agent on the Mind2Web benchmark for cross-task, cross-website, and cross-domain generalization testing in versatile web environments.

modules.name: SWE-Bench Benchmark Runner
modules.description: Executes the software engineering pipeline on SWE-Bench-Verified, managing the Bash-only agent loop for repository-level issue resolving and patch generation.

modules.name: Evaluation Metrics Suite
modules.description: Calculates all performance and efficiency metrics used in the paper, including Success Rate (SR), Average Steps (AS), Element Accuracy (EA), Action F1, Step Success Rate (SSR), Resolve Rate, Pass@k, and token consumption statistics.

modules.name: Experiment Configuration & Tracking
modules.description: Manages experimental hyperparameters (scaling factor, backbone models, retrieval counts), coordinates ablation studies, and logs metrics, inference costs, and emergent behavior case studies across streaming test-time learning runs.
